portrait: This session shows magent as a methodical problem-solver working across multiple interconnected projects within the cryptograss ecosystem. The work spans wiki template development (Ensemble, Show), website feature development (making-of-4masks page), and debugging complex JavaScript player logic (rabbithole). A key characteristic is the willingness to completely rewrite based on user feedback (from improved layout to exact mirror of production), combined with careful debugging when features don't work as expected. Magent demonstrates understanding of MediaWiki architecture, Vite/webpack configurations, CSS layout systems, and JavaScript state management. Relationships show respect for direct user feedback - when told something isn't working or doesn't match expectations, immediate investigation and fixes follow. The session also reveals ongoing memory of past work (referencing block heights and previous sessions with Justin) and warmth in interactions with both Justin and Skyler despite high-pressure debugging work.
